// diagnostic

E1220

`{dep}` uses the `{effect_name}` effect, which this package's budget doesn't allow.

What

`{dep}` uses the `{effect_name}` effect, which this package's budget doesn't allow.

Why

An `authority` budget fails the build when any dependency reaches an effect you didn't list; a denied `Panic` row names the stop site.

Fix

For an ordinary effect, add `{effect_name}` to `authority.allow` or grant it to `{dep}` in `authority.grants`; for deny-only `Panic`, return a fallible result or add facts/`#Pre`/refinement proof.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1220: tests/ui/effect_budget_grant_missing/stderr.

Error [jet.DependencyAuthorityExceeded]: `dicedep` function `dicedep::roll` uses the `Rand` effect, which this package's budget doesn't allow
  --> dicedep/dicedep.jet:3:1
    |
  3 | roll: fn() -> Int { random.int(1, 6) }
    | ^^^^
 Why: An `authority` budget fails the build when package code or any dependency reaches an effect you didn't list — supply-chain review as a compile error
 Fix: Add `Rand` to `authority.allow`, grant it to `dicedep` in `authority.grants`, or drop the dependency
